bio.text: Nydia Velázquez has represented New York's 7th Congressional District since her election in 1992 and is serving her seventeenth term; she was the first Puerto Rican woman elected to the U.S. House.
Born in Yabucoa, Puerto Rico, she graduated from the University of Puerto Rico in 1974 with a degree in political science and earned a master's degree from New York University.
Before Congress she taught at Hunter College, was Special Assistant to Rep. Edolphus Towns, and in 1984 became the first Latina appointed to the New York City Council.
